subject: Renewal: burst credit proposal + commit adjustment for OrchidAI
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@orchidai.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orchidai.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal + unexpected November spike

Hi Mateo,

Quick heads-up as we approach our renewal window: November traffic spiked ~2.8x due to a marketing campaign and our inference spend exceeded our committed tokens by ~24%. We ran some internal perf checks and saw a modest latency uplift (p95 moved from 190ms to ~260ms) during peak windows.

We want to avoid accelerating to the next tier without understanding options — curious if Redwood can propose a short-term buffer (burst credits) while we renegotiate a revised commit for Q1. Also need a high-level ROI recap to present to finance (unit cost today, expected cost with proposed commit, and estimated payback period).

Can you send a sketch by end of week? Procurement is looping in, they may ask for contract language on burst usage.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Platform
OrchidAI
[Attachment: orchid_usage_nov2026.csv (CSV, 58KB)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@orchidai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + unexpected November spike

Samantha — thanks for the note and the CSV, that helped. High-level response below and I attached a short ROI deck.

Summary:
- Root cause: marketing-driven short-tail peak; request profile shows many short-chained completions (avg tokens/req down ~15%) but total tokens up.
- Perf: p95 latency bump correlates with concurrent-batch saturation on a small set of routes; ops has an action plan (minor shard rebalancing) that reduces p95 back to ~200ms within 48 hours.

Proposed short-term plan:
1) Burst credit pool: 150M token burst credit applied to your account, valid for 60 days. Credits are consumed only when committed capacity is exhausted and auto-burst engages.
2) Adjusted commit proposal: move from 1.2B -> 1.6B committed tokens / quarter (33% uplift). Net effective unit price with a 6-month commit discount = $0.0009/token.
3) Ops mitigations: temporary route pinning + shard rebalance during next 7-day window; we will schedule a live run with your infra team to verify.

ROI sketch (attached): with the proposed commit + burst credits we estimate a 22% reduction in per-token cost compared to current overage spending if your post-campaign baseline returns to Q3 levels. Payback on the incremental commit (~$48k additional quarterly spend) is ~9–11 weeks assuming conservative usage.

Next steps I need from you:
- Procurement contact for draft SOW and any contractual constraints on temporary credits
- Confirmation that engineering can join a 30-min ops window on Tuesday (Nov 24) for the shard rebalancing test

I copied Lauren for the commercial terms and Marissa for billing/credits.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: roi-burst-credit-model-v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@orchidai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + unexpected November spike

Quick note on the commercials and approval flow:

Commercial proposal (draft):
- Quarterly commit: 1.6B tokens (3x quarters rolling)
- List price: $0.0012/token -> negotiated effective $0.0009/token for first 6 months (volume + 6-mo prepay)
- Burst credit: one-time 150M token credit applied against overages for 60 days
- Cancellation: standard 30-day notice; credits do not create a recurring liability

Internal approvals required:
- I need a quick confirm from Revenue Ops for the 6-mo prepay concession and Finance for the credit accounting (Marissa copied).
- If procurement wants contract-level language, we can add a short rider that defines burst credit behavior (first-call fallback, consumed sequentially after commit).

Samantha — if you want more elbow room on the credit size we can consider 250M but would require an extended commit or a small one-time usage fee. Let me know which direction you prefer.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@orchidai.com>, procurement@orchidai.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Summary & next steps — commit + burst credit (OrchidAI)

Samantha / Procurement team — following up with the consolidated proposal and asks:

1) Redwood will provision a 150M token burst credit (60 days) upon signature of the 1.6B quarterly commit term sheet. Credits apply only when commit is exhausted; they will not affect routing or isolation.
2) Proposed financials: effective $0.0009/token for first 6 months with a 3-quarter commitment cadence.
3) Ops: scheduled shard rebalance test on Tue Nov 24 is confirmed — Mateo and Marissa will send runbook and Slack channel 24 hours ahead.

Action items for OrchidAI:
- Procurement: send PO or redline requests by end of day Tue Nov 30 so legal can prioritize a rider for burst-credit language.
- Engineering: confirm attendee list for the Nov 24 test (30 mins).
- Finance: confirm whether a 6-mo prepay is viable on your side or if you prefer the extended-commit + partial prepay alternative.

If you'd like, we can set a 20-minute exec recap next Wednesday to run this past your CFO — happy to join.

Thanks and talk soon,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
